## product_comparison_board

> Vertical 4:5 side-by-side comparison of three product variants with feature checkboxes by axis.

**Artifact:** `infographic`, `1024x1280`, aspect `4:5`
**Demo vars:** `templates/product/_vars_examples/product_comparison_board.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A vertical 4:5 product comparison board for Apex Pour Kettle — Compare the Lineup. Three product variants — labeled Stovetop 0.9L, Electric 1.0L, and Pro 1.5L — sit in three equally weighted columns, each topped with a small product silhouette and followed by a matching list of feature rows. Each feature row carries a checkbox or a dash indicating presence by variant, organized around the capacity, heat-source, and temperature control axis.
[2. Action] The viewer scans top-to-bottom within each column, then sweeps horizontally across rows to compare the same feature across variants. The composition is fixed and readable — no animation, no toggle, no carousel; this is a quiet decision-support figure.
[3. Scene] Document-grade flat field: warm off-white background with very faint paper grain, calibrated for both screen comparison and printed handouts. No environment, no human models, no in-use scenario.
[4. Composition] Vertical 4:5 frame. Top ~10% holds the title in a single line. Below it, three equal-width columns split the remaining frame with a 4% gutter. Each column's top ~20% shows a small product silhouette and the variant label beneath. Below that, a stack of feature rows, each row a single line with a left-aligned feature name and a right-aligned check / dash mark. Hairline horizontal rules separate rows. Bottom ~6% margin reserved as safe area.
[5. Style] Editorial design-press comparison aesthetic. Palette: warm off- white background, charcoal type, a single quiet accent (forest green) reserved for affirmative checkmarks. Type system: geometric sans-serif headline, slightly lighter weight body. No color-coding by variant beyond the checkmark accent — the columns are visually equal in weight. No gloss, no 3D, no decorative gradients.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- title: "Apex Pour Kettle — Compare the Lineup"
- axis: "Compared by: capacity, heat-source, and temperature control"
- variant_a_label: "A. Stovetop 0.9L"
- variant_b_label: "B. Electric 1.0L"
- variant_c_label: "C. Pro 1.5L"

NO: human models, lifestyle photography, 3D chrome reflections, rainbow gradients, lens flare, watermarks, cartoon mascots, sale-price stickers, busy promotional badges
```

## product_feature_callout

> Hero shot of one product with three feature callouts arranged around it on a horizontal canvas.

**Artifact:** `infographic`, `1920x1088`, aspect `16:9`
**Demo vars:** `templates/product/_vars_examples/product_feature_callout.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A horizontal 16:9 product feature board centered on a single hero unit of Apex Pour Kettle, with three short feature callouts arranged around it. Each callout pairs a small flat icon, a thin leader line touching the relevant area of the product, and a one-line label drawn from Counterweighted handle, Triple-wall vacuum body, and Precision gooseneck spout.
[2. Action] The eye locks onto the product first, then traces each leader line outward to its callout in clockwise order. The composition reads as a still hero, not as a kinetic launch animation — there are no motion lines, no progressive reveal, just a quiet annotated portrait.
[3. Scene] Editorial studio backdrop in a quiet warm slate-tinted neutral, with a soft floor-shadow grounding the product. No environment, no in-use scenario, no model. Lighting is a single soft key from upper-left, with very subtle ambient fill — no specular highlights, no glamour rim.
[4. Composition] Wide 16:9 frame. Product occupies the central ~46% width. Three callouts sit at roughly 10 o'clock, 2 o'clock, and 5 o'clock positions relative to the product, each with: a small flat icon, a hairline leader line ending at the relevant product feature, and a short label set in two lines max. Outer 5% safe margin. Product name sits in a small caption at the top center (~7% top margin).
[5. Style] Premium product-launch microsite aesthetic. Palette: warm slate backdrop, charcoal type, one quiet metallic neutral on the icons, no third color. Type system: geometric sans-serif at body weight, title weight reserved for the product name. Materials feel matte-precise — no glossy chrome, no glitter, no neon. Hairline leader lines (~1.5px) end in a small dot at the product surface.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- product_name: "Apex Pour Kettle"
- feature1: "1. Counterweighted handle"
- feature2: "2. Triple-wall vacuum body"
- feature3: "3. Precision gooseneck spout"

NO: human models, lifestyle photography, retail shelf context, lens flare, rainbow gradients, 3D chrome reflections, watermarks, cartoon mascots, glossy plastic specular highlights, busy background patterns
```

## product_packaging_concept

> Single-product packaging concept rendering — branded box / bottle / pouch on a minimal studio backdrop.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1024`, aspect `1:1`
**Demo vars:** `templates/product/_vars_examples/product_packaging_concept.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A 1:1 branded packaging concept render for Helio Field's Cold-Brew Concentrate. The package — a uncoated kraft paperboard box, bottle, or pouch — is rendered as a single hero unit centered on an editorial studio backdrop. Brand wordmark is set on the package face along with the tagline, with a slim accent stripe in burnt sienna establishing the visual identity.
[2. Action] The viewer's eye lands on the wordmark, drops to the tagline, and only then registers the surface texture of the uncoated kraft paperboard. No in-use scene, no model holding the package, no retail-shelf context — this is a design-studio mood shot, not a sales hero.
[3. Scene] Editorial studio: a soft graduated paper-grey backdrop sweeping from a ~3% darker top to a ~3% lighter floor, with a soft floor-shadow grounding the package. Lighting is a single soft key from upper-left, no rim light, no specular gloss, no environmental reflections.
[4. Composition] Square 1:1 frame. Package occupies the central ~60% area, framed with generous negative space. Brand wordmark sits within the package face, naturally aligned to its surface geometry. Tagline appears either on the package or as a small typeset line under the package, never as a floating banner. Bottom ~10% reserved as safe area; product line label may sit there as a subdued caption.
[5. Style] Design-press editorial aesthetic, reminiscent of premium D&AD- annual photography. Palette anchored on burnt sienna with neutral paper-grey backdrop and one warm neutral. Type system: a refined geometric or quiet humanist sans-serif (Söhne / Neue Haas Grotesk family). Materials feel matte, paperboard, or softly tactile — no glossy chrome, no plastic specular highlights, no marketing-loud color.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- brand_name: "Helio Field"
- product_line: "Cold-Brew Concentrate"
- tagline: "Roasted slow. Served cold."

NO: retail shelf context, human models, lifestyle photography, lens flare, rainbow gradients, watermarks, existing famous brand logos, 3D chrome reflections, cartoon mascots, glossy plastic specular highlights
```
